text:
```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name == 'spellshift/realm'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download flaky report artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: ./artifacts
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/flaky-monitor.sh
          ./scripts/flaky-monitor.sh ./artifacts/flaky-report.json

      - name: Upload updated flaky report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: ./artifacts/flaky-report.json

      - name: Report status to Slack
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
        with:
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
